answer: Each agent must post a bonded stake whose identity is anchored to a unique graph vertex, so a sybil cluster cannot reuse one credential across many puppet accounts without fragmenting its own capital. At each epoch dawn, a randomized liveness pulse samples a quorum of vertices to cross-attest stake provenance, forcing colluders to expose correlated registration timing. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
